pages.name: Projects register
pages.what: The list of exploration projects (properties): one row per project with its id, name, commodity, jurisdiction, stage in the pipeline, status, project geologist (a dashed 'vacant' chip when the role is unfilled), area under tenure, fiscal-year budget, spent with a progress bar, forecast against budget and next gate date. Active projects are shown by default; the left panel cuts the register to on-hold or closed projects, to one commodity or to one stage, and the Find box narrows by id, name or jurisdiction. Each id or name opens that project's record.

pages.name: Project record, Overview tab
pages.what: One project's summary: fiscal-year budget and spend, area under tenure, holes drilled, significant intercepts and the latest estimate; the description and team (exploration manager, project geologist); the stage history through the pipeline; recent programmes; open items (pending approvals, batches on QAQC hold, expiring tenements); and the comments panel, where typing @ and a colleague's first name notifies them. The header carries Watch, Edit and Stage-gate decision; the tab strip leads to the project's Tenure, Programmes, Drilling, Assays, Resource, Budget, Approvals and Activity.
pages.not_here: Tenement renewal (Lodge renewal): the Tenure tab. The budget ledger and monthly spend: the Budget tab. Every approval raised on the project: the Approvals tab; the audit trail: Activity. Deciding a request: the request's own page in Approvals. Budget, commodity and jurisdiction: set at creation; later changes go through support. A heading reading 'Project not found' means the address holds an unknown project id; the Projects register lists every project.

pages.name: Stage-gate decision dialog
pages.what: Records the decision that ends the project's current stage. Exactly one decision is chosen: Advance to the next stage (from the final Stage-gate decision stage, advancing hands the project to the development group and closes it in exploration); Place on hold at the current stage (or Resume, when the project is on hold); or Relinquish, which closes the project, lapses its tenure at the next expiry and makes its records read-only. A reasoning of at least twenty characters is required and is written verbatim to the audit log; the project team is notified.
pages.not_here: A formal stage-gate review with a gate pack: raised as a request in Approvals; this dialog records the decision itself. Changing only the next gate date: the Edit dialog.

(Record decision needs at least 20)':' (long enough)')+(err?'; error shown: '+err.textContent.trim():''); })()

controls.region: Edit project dialog, top right cross
controls.what: Closes the dialog without saving.
controls.not_for: Saving (that is Save).

controls.what: The project's name. Required; an empty name is not saved.
controls.not_for: The project id, fixed by auto-numbering.

controls.what: Reassigns the project geologist. The active geologists are selectable; inactive ones are listed for reference.
controls.not_for: The exploration manager, assigned automatically.

controls.what: The project manager's forecast of spend at fiscal year end, in the base currency.
controls.not_for: The approved budget, set at creation; later changes go through support.

controls.what: The project's free-text description.
controls.not_for: Posting a comment.

controls.what: Closes the dialog and discards the changes.
controls.not_for: Saving.

controls.what: Saves the changes to the project and closes the dialog ('Project saved').
controls.not_for: Recording a stage-gate decision or submitting anything for approval.

controls.region: Stage-gate decision dialog, top right cross
controls.what: Closes the dialog without recording anything.
controls.not_for: Recording the decision.

controls.what: Choose to advance the project to the next pipeline stage named in the label. From the final stage the label says it hands over to the development group, which closes the project in exploration.
controls.not_for: Holding or relinquishing. Record decision records the choice.

controls.what: Choose to place the project on hold at its current stage.
controls.not_for: Closing the project (that is Relinquish). Offered while the project is active.

controls.what: Choose to resume a project that is on hold, at its current stage.
controls.not_for: Advancing it. Offered only while the project is on hold.

controls.what: Choose to relinquish: closes the project, lapses its tenements at the next expiry and makes its records read-only. Permanent in the application; the confirm button turns red.
controls.not_for: Putting the project on hold (that is Place on hold).

controls.what: The reasoning for the decision: what the results showed and why. At least twenty characters; written to the audit log verbatim.
controls.not_for: A comment on the project. Record decision needs at least twenty characters here.

controls.what: Closes the dialog without recording a decision.
controls.not_for: Recording the decision.

controls.what: Records the chosen decision with the reasoning, notifies the project team and closes the dialog.
controls.not_for: Requesting approval (Approvals). With reasoning under twenty characters it shows an error and the dialog stays open.

controls.region: Lodge a renewal dialog, top right cross
controls.what: Closes the dialog without lodging.
controls.not_for: Lodging the renewal.

controls.region: Lodge a renewal dialog, bottom right
controls.what: Closes the dialog without lodging.
controls.not_for: Lodging the renewal.

controls.region: Lodge a renewal dialog, bottom right
controls.what: Lodges the renewal: creates the tenement-renewal approval request (Finance expenditure check, then Tenure lodgement) and marks the tenement 'renewal lodged'.
controls.not_for: Approving the renewal; that happens step by step on the request in Approvals.
